entities.name: Abbas-Ali Amid Zanjani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abbas-Ali Amid Zanjani was an Iranian politician and cleric. He was the only cleric president of University of Tehran, who himself had no academic education of any kind, that served from 2005 to 2008.
